description: Documents the specific error scenario of API-058 (View Payment) where the payment exists but does not belong to the caller's organization/branch (tenant isolation). Same endpoint as API-058, isolated here to preserve the original docs/API_Contracts_and_Test_Results.xlsx functionality numbering.

path_parameters.paymentId: uuid - belongs to a different organization/branch than the caller in this scenario

validation: payment.organization_id and payment.branch_id must match the caller's tenant scope

success.status_definition: N/A - this functionality ID documents only the failure path; see API-058 for the success contract

errors.condition: paymentId exists but belongs to a different organization or branch

notes: Since /api/payments/{paymentId} is not org/branch path-scoped (see API-058 notes), this tenant-isolation check must be enforced entirely at the API layer by comparing payment.organization_id/branch_id against the authenticated caller's session context - there is no path parameter to validate against.
